calls.title: The second reader waits on a new xAI subscription
calls.text: Sam, 2026-10-20 about 16:30 UTC: the API is paid for separately from the Grok subscription, and the account is moving to the RCCD district credit card. When the key exists: Sam sets XAI_API_KEY and XAI_MODEL as Edge Function secrets on the Work Plan project, a session deploys program-requirements-extract with cpl-chat-deploy.yml, then runs second-reader.yml for Canada College.
calls.no_reply: The second reader stays built and unrun; the records that fail a machine check are read by one model and Jev's sittings, whose verdicts files carry each college's next fix.

answer.words: Later, on Open Asks Sheet 98 card 2: "I need to get a new subscription first which will take a few days, so keep this on ice for now."

calls.title: Ask Program Mapper's vendor to share the 63 community colleges' program maps
calls.text: Sam pasted the vendor's member list on 2026-10-21; 37 map hosts are now on the registry (#2330). Every mapper host the reader has reached answers 403, so the maps are known and unread. A request to the vendor is outward, so it waits on Sam.
